extracted.intended_audience: citizens, civic organizations, and public institutions evaluating or deploying a digital citizen-participation platform
extracted.subtask_description: Information for selecting or implementing a digital platform (Decidim) to run participatory democratic processes, describing functional features, values, and guarantees important to organizers and governments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Free/libre, open and safe technology
rubrics_metrics.guidance: “It's yours. Use it. Share it. Improve it.” A platform designed entirely with free software and open, collaborative content thanks to the Metadecidim community — emphasis on reuse, forking and community contributions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Democratic guarantees
rubrics_metrics.description: With all democratic guarantees. Reprogramming democracy is now possible with Decidim.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Positioning the platform as providing the institutional guarantees required for democratic processes; implies adherence to principles that protect fairness and legitimacy of participation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transparency, traceability and integrity of information
rubrics_metrics.description: Decidim ensures transparency, traceability and integrity of information like never before.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Platform design prioritizes recordable, auditable processes and visible decision trails so participants and administrators can understand how inputs map to outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Security, privacy and confidentiality
rubrics_metrics.description: It provides security, privacy and confidentiality to all participants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Technical and policy measures to protect participant data and communications are core features; these are presented alongside transparency and integrity as essential democratic requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Flexible democratic governance (configurability)
rubrics_metrics.description: Implementing a flexible democratic system. We can help configure a system of democratic governance in all kinds of organizations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The platform supports configurable governance models so different organizations can adapt processes, roles and rules to their institutional needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support for a wide range of participatory processes
rubrics_metrics.description: Strategic planning; Participatory processes; Assemblies; Initiatives and citizen consultations; Participatory budgeting; Networked communication.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Decidim provides feature sets tailored to multiple process types (planning, consultations, budgets, assemblies, etc.), enabling organizers to pick the appropriate module or workflow for their objective.

rubrics_metrics.name: Community-driven values encoded in design
rubrics_metrics.description: Open platforms such as Decidim ... is open source so other people can fork it, reuse it and build a process. It also has these values that we want to reflect in our society encoded in the way it's designed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Beyond code licensing, the community (Metadecidim) and the social contract shape design decisions: inclusivity, openness, and civic values are built into UX and governance features.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support for self-organization at every scale (scalability)
rubrics_metrics.description: Decidim helps citizens, organizations and public institutions self-organize democratically at every scale.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes ability to be deployed in contexts ranging from small groups to citywide or multi-organization processes without losing functionality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Monitoring and tracking implementation of proposals
rubrics_metrics.description: You can monitor at all times the state of implementation of the approved proposals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lifecycle tracking for proposals — from submission through approval to implementation — enabling transparency and accountability about whether and how decisions are carried out.

rubrics_metrics.name: Capacity for co-production and handling large volumes of input
rubrics_metrics.description: Co-produce a strategic city plan together with the citizens... this plan includes almost 7 thousand citizen proposals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Platform must be able to support co-creation workflows and scale to thousands of proposals/interactions while preserving manageability and participant engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proven adoption and trust
rubrics_metrics.description: Hundreds of organizations around the world trust Decidim for their democratic processes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Deployment history and institutional trust are cited as evidence of suitability; prospective users can consider breadth of adoption as a criterion when evaluating platforms.
